entries.producer: O'Reilly Media (IDPF accessible-epub-3 sample, Matt Garrish)
entries.basis: EPUB/package.opf nested OPF; nav opens with the EPUB 3.3 spec's own <!DOCTYPE html> template (the 12-08 Rule 1 DTD-guard fix); 5 depth-1 nav entries (Preface, ch01-ch04) over a 3-level TOC — depth-2/3 sections merge; leading front-matter spine range (cover + spi-ad + index) assembles to 13 blocks, admits at the D12-10 floor, but its offset-0 anchor-gate sample resolves 'ambiguous' (the chapter opens with TWO relative-src images downgraded to the reader's IDENTICAL unsupported-block fallback description, so the opening quote legitimately matches twice with no disambiguating prefix — ANNO-07) and the unit is skipped + disclosed per D12-11; 5 = Preface + 4 chapters (0.4-conclusion range absorbs the trailing colophon doc)

7 depth-1 nav entries; the 27 publisher-split chapter spine files merge under the single 'Dracula' depth-1 entry (28 depth-2 sections stay in-chapter — D12-09 merge); real front matter before the main unit; Dedication + Preface are single-paragraph documents (1 walked block) and legitimately fail the D12-10 minChapterBlocks=3 floor as disclosed skips; 5 = Titlepage + Imprint + Dracula(main, 174 blocks) + Colophon + Uncopyright

Flat 38-entry depth-1 nav TOC (Titlepage, Imprint, chapters I-XXXIV, Colophon, Uncopyright), every unit passes the D12-10 floor (3-126 walked blocks); real front matter (title page + imprint before chapter I); 38 admitted, 0 disclosed skips

8 depth-1 nav entries over a nested TOC; the entire novel (34 spine docs, 2219 walked blocks) merges under the single 'Nostromo' depth-1 entry; Epigraph (2 blocks) + Dedication (1 block) legitimately fail the D12-10 floor as disclosed skips; 6 = Titlepage + Imprint + Author's Note + Nostromo(main) + Colophon + Uncopyright

OEBPS/content.opf nested OPF; 3 depth-1 nav entries (Chapter 1, Chapter 2, Copyright); the nav document itself sits at spine position 0 and is structurally skipped; Copyright page walks to 2 blocks and legitimately fails the D12-10 floor as a disclosed skip; Chapter 1 is Lorem Ipsum whose opening 20 graphemes appear 3x in the chapter's real text, so its offset-0 anchor-gate sample resolves 'ambiguous' (empty prefix at position 0 cannot disambiguate — ANNO-07 honesty) and the chapter is skipped + disclosed per D12-11; 1 = Chapter 2 only

OEBPS/content.opf nested OPF; image-heavy book (cover wrapper page + inline figures — the D12-16 figure downgrade surface); 16 depth-1 nav entries of which the first 3 share one href (title page duplicates collapse to the first — two units ignored, not chapters); the leading cover-wrapper spine range has no text-bearing block and is a disclosed skip; 13 = title document + CHAPTER I-XII

6 depth-1 nav entries over a deep-nested TOC (11 depth-2 part sections); the entire novel (107 publisher-split spine docs, 3290 walked blocks) merges under the single 'Buddenbrooks' depth-1 entry; real front matter (title page, imprint, translator's note before the half-title); every unit passes the D12-10 floor; 6 admitted, 0 disclosed skips

single_entry_toc.reason: No suitably licensed real-world publication was identified; synthetic fixtures were deliberately excluded from this corpus.

minimal_v2_two_block_template.reason: The IDPF minimal-v2 packaging template (1908 bytes, dc:title 'Your title here', one 2-block section document) legitimately fails the D12-10 minChapterBlocks=3 admission floor and refuses epub-empty — it is a packaging template, not a real publication, so it is recorded here rather than pinned as a false refusal. Consequence: the ncx_primary_toc shape (a book whose TOC resolves ONLY through an EPUB 2 NCX) is unrepresented by an admitting corpus book — every admitted book carries an EPUB 3 nav document the reader correctly prefers (EPUB 3.3 §5.9.5); NCX resolution remains covered by the committed 12-01/12-02 synthetic suite (tests/unit/server/epub-to-books.spec.ts, ncxOnlyBook + fallback blocks).
